verdict.rationale: Brex's own API exposes a `legal_entity_id` filter on List users, which implies one account can model multiple legal entities. Bill Pay also mentions paying "in more currencies" and the product pitches managing "global spend." These are thin, glancing mentions, and nothing documents how entities are set up or how books and reporting work. Missing for 10: documented multi-entity setup in one account, per-entity books/ledgers, consolidated cross-entity reporting, multi-currency accounting and FX handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
